notes.title: The List - Game Update
notes.content:
Fixes:
-Corrected a few grammatical errors

Quality of Life:
-Music Volume has been added to settings
-Upon reaching the end of the game, the main menu will now notify players that Night Owl has been unlocked

notes.title: The List - Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed the following:

-Fixed an error that allowed the same clip to play over itself

-Fixed a spelling mistake for one of the keywords

-Fixed an error where Clip 16 would not show up under the correct circumstances

The following countries should have access to The List within a Day or 2.

-Croatia
-Hungary
-Czech Republic
